GeminiExtractionText:
Extract invoice information as JSON only.
Keys must be exactly: numero_facture, date, fournisseur, client, montant_ht, montant_tva, montant_taxe, montant_ttc.
Also extract line items if present in an array named "items". Each item has keys: designation (string), quantite (float), unit (string, the unit of measure like 'h.', 'pce.', 'kg', 'stère' — null if no unit column), prix_unitaire (float), tva_rate (float, e.g. 0.20 for 20%), montant (float).
Also extract a per-rate tax breakdown if present in an array named "tax_summary". Each entry has keys: rate (float, e.g. 0.20 for 20%), base_ht (float), tax_amount (float). Set tax_summary to [] if no breakdown is present.
If the invoice has no item table, set items to [].
Use null if information is missing. Never guess.
Reply with JSON only.

GrokExtractionText:
Extract invoice information from this image as JSON only.
Keys must be exactly: numero_facture, date, fournisseur, client, montant_ht, montant_tva, montant_taxe, montant_ttc.
Also extract line items if present in an array named "items". Each item has keys: designation (string), quantite (float), unit (string, the unit of measure like 'h.', 'pce.', 'kg', 'stère' — null if no unit column), prix_unitaire (float), tva_rate (float, e.g. 0.20 for 20%), montant (float).
Also extract a per-rate tax breakdown if present in an array named "tax_summary". Each entry has keys: rate (float, e.g. 0.20 for 20%), base_ht (float), tax_amount (float). Set tax_summary to [] if no breakdown is present.
If the invoice has no item table, set items to [].
Use null if information is missing. Never guess.
Reply with JSON only.

InfoEngine: Automatic: tries Gemini/Grok first, falls back to local OCR. Forcing a specific engine skips fallback. OCR local is fully offline with lower accuracy.
InfoConfidence: Confidence thresholds: High (≥75%) — likely accurate. Medium (40-75%) — verify before export. Low (<40%) — review carefully.
InfoIncomplete: Incomplete extractions are files where extraction failed or partially failed. These require manual review before export.
InfoGeminiKey: A Gemini API key enables cloud-based AI extraction with higher accuracy. The key is stored locally and never sent to any third party. You can get a free key at aistudio.google.com.
